console_dial_no_wake_address: {host} has no wake address on record
console_pair_status_pairing: Pairing… confirm the PIN on the host
console_pair_status_requesting: Approve this device in the host's web console
console_dial_approve_no_pin_unnamed: Approve this device on the Devices page of the host's web console — no PIN needed.
console_unlock_stay_signed_in_off_a11y: Stay signed in on this device, off
console_unlock_stay_signed_in_on_a11y: Stay signed in on this device, on
console_home_pair_for_games_body: Pair with {host} to see its games here.
console_home_asleep_body: {host} is asleep. Wake it to see its games.
console_home_offline_body: {host} is offline. Its games show here once it is back.
console_card_unpaired_body: Unpaired {host}. The next connect asks for a PIN.
console_card_not_default_body: {host} is no longer the default host
console_card_connect_with_body: This connect only; the card keeps its own preset.
console_card_pinned_card_body: A shortcut to one preset on this host. Unpinning it changes nothing about the host or the preset.
console_speedtest_preset_sets_body: “{preset}” sets this host's bitrate — change it there to use this.
console_lib_sections_foot: The Games tab shows these in this order. An empty section stays hidden.
console_lib_not_paired: Not paired — pair with the host first.
console_lib_pin_changed: Host certificate changed — pair again with a PIN.
console_lib_timeout: The host is answering too slowly.
console_lib_tls: Couldn't secure the connection to the host.
console_lib_identity: Couldn't load this device's pairing identity.
console_logs_too_large: Log file too large to send (1 MB limit).
console_logs_refused: {host} refused the logs — pair with it again.
console_ring_edit_swap: Move to a slot and press {button} to swap
console_ring_editor_hint: Point the stick at a button: {confirm} changes it, {lift} picks it up to swap; a pointer clicks or drags.
console_gamepad_ui_enabled_hint: Opens the app in the controller interface; off returns to the touch interface right away.
console_gamepad_ui_enabled_webos_hint: Opens the app in the controller interface; off returns to the cursor interface right away.
console_gamepad_ui_mode_hint: When the controller interface opens: with a controller attached, or always, for a device docked to a TV.
console_gamepad_ui_mode_webos_hint: When the controller interface opens: with a controller connected, or always.
console_reduce_ui_resolution_webos_hint: Draws the backdrop smaller and slower so the controller interface stays smooth; streams don't change.
console_prefs_advanced_changed_hint: Some hidden settings differ from a fresh install; {button} shows them.
console_player_overlay_actions_hint: Six buttons and the shortcuts they send, opened in a stream with a two-finger twist or {keys}.
console_prefs_controllers_hint: The controllers connected to this device, their grants and a rumble test.
console_preset_row_hint: Its settings, name and hosts; a pinned preset shows as its own card that connects with one press.
console_preset_new_hint: A preset bundles stream settings for one use, like low latency or quality; pin it to a host as its own card.
console_preset_name_hint: Name it for what it is for: Couch, Low latency, Travel. The name shows on the cards it is pinned to.
console_preset_editor_hint: A dot marks what this preset changes, the rest follows Settings; {button} puts a row back.
console_preset_pin_empty: No saved hosts yet — pair with a host first, then pin this preset to it.
console_preset_bind_empty: No presets yet — create them in the desktop app, then choose one here.
console_preset_bind_game_hint: What this game streams with, instead of the host's default; a pinned card keeps its own.
console_pad_grants_card_a11y: Controller not showing? Opens the access list
console_pad_none_line: Connect one to see it here
console_pad_not_forwarded_reason_a11y: Not forwarded — not recognized as a controller
console_pad_none_detail: Punktfunk only forwards what the system sees as a controller or joystick; one behind an adapter or hub may show as the adapter, or not at all.
console_pad_grants_detail: A wired DualSense or Steam Controller 2 needs USB access before it can be captured, and a Steam Controller 2 over Bluetooth needs Bluetooth access to be seen at all.
console_pad_grants_detail_open: {button} lists the grants and a haptics test.
console_pad_test_controller_detail: Shows every button, trigger and stick as the controller sends it, to tell a worn button from a setting.
console_pad_rumble_detail: A short pulse on the controller's motors: is the motor wired, and does the host reach it.
console_pad_test_blurb: Every button and stick on the controller shows here.
console_pad_test_prompt: Press a button or move a stick
console_pad_sc2_usb_detail: A wired or Puck-dongle Steam Controller 2 needs USB access to be captured; until then it stays in its built-in keyboard/mouse mode.
console_pad_ds_usb_detail: A wired DualSense or DualShock 4 needs USB access to be captured — with it, streams drive rumble, adaptive triggers, lightbar and gyro directly.
console_pad_ds_haptics_detail: Play a short tone through a wired DualSense's audio endpoint, to tell a controller that can't do haptics from a stream that isn't sending them.
console_calibration_black_step: Step 1 of 3. Lower until the pattern is no longer visible.
console_calibration_peak_step: Step 2 of 3. With the TV's Tone Mapping on HGIG, raise until the pattern is no longer visible.
console_calibration_frame_step: Step 3 of 3. Raise one step at a time, pausing after each. Stop as soon as a step no longer makes the screen brighter.
console_calibration_stalled: The video plane did not accept the test pattern. The values below are unchanged.
console_webos_calibration_needs_hdr: HDR calibration needs an HDR-capable TV.
console_webos_overlay_audio_ndl: {route} {layout} · NDL · lead {lead} ms · av stamp {offset} ms
console_webos_overlay_pacing: pace cushion {cushion} ms · jitter {jitter} ms · late {late}
console_webos_stop_body: The stream will end and you'll return to the menu.
console_switch_applet_mode: Opened from the Album, Punktfunk has little memory and may close — hold {button} while starting a game to open it with full memory.
